title: Vampire tuned for level 50
changes: Vampire skills that take 5 ranks now open ranks 4 and 5 at level 30 and level 40, so the tree keeps growing in the desert. Crimson Tide and Nightfall now go to rank 5.
Blood skills hit softer (Crimson Tide, Exsanguinate, Blood Lance, Boil Blood, Blood Link), and so do Crimson Slash, Night Pounce and the Brides.
Night is stronger: Bat Swarm, Rat Plague and Nightfall hit harder and heal more, the bat shield blocks 15%, and Native Soil heals faster.
Heroes holding ranks 4 or 5 below the new levels get those skill points back.
